name: Tank Rush
author: Red Horizon
description: Armour rolls off the line cheaper and faster: every tank costs 25% less and drives 25% faster, War Factories are cheaper, and the Soviets get the Rhino, a lighter and quicker Heavy Tank built for the rush.

rhino.name: Rhino Tank
rhino.description: Lighter, faster variant of the Heavy Tank. Trades armour for tempo.
